name: Gao tim than
summary: Gạo tím than is purple rice. The Da Nang Fatherland Front’s 2021 list gives it 3 stars and names Lò gạch cũ Farmstay in thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh. The 22–24 Sep 2023 fair calls it gạo tím than lò gạch cũ.
origin: Thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh, in the Fatherland Front’s 2021 list.
howToEat: Neither note describes a dish made from the rice. The method is Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Lò gạch cũ Farmstay, thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh. No street number. Check on arrival.
